name: Jueyun Peak
desc: The Jueyun Peaks spear into the sea of clouds, linked by iron chains and cloud bridges over perilous mountain paths. Only those who can truly steady their sword intent may climb to the highest reaches. Midway up stand sword-testing platforms, sword-washing pools, and sheer cliffs carved with countless blade marks; higher still, the wind grows sharper and lightning sometimes flashes past the precipices. The entire mountain gate feels like an ancient sword drawn but never sheathed, austere, towering, and edged with cold menace.

name: Ten Thousand Beasts Cave
desc: Myriad Beasts Cavern lies hidden in the depths of the mountain ranges, its outer layers sealed by miasma and tangled vines that form a natural barrier. Only by going deeper does one reach the descending beast domains within. Stone bridges, iron gates, and beast-taming platforms divide the layers, while low roars and clashing chains echo without end through air thick with lingering demon qi. Bones and claw marks scatter across the ground. This is less a normal mountain gate than a living nest-city of colossal beasts, and every lower level feels more oppressive than the last.

name: Silent Sea Cliff
desc: Jinghaiya hangs above a sheer sea cliff, where halls, corridors, and tide-viewing terraces of frost spirit jade lie half-veiled in ocean mist. From afar, the entire mountain gate seems to float inside moonlight and surf. At the cliffside, the jade wall reflects sea and stars, and as the tides rise and fall, watery gleams ripple across walls and floors until paths seem half real and half illusion. It is so quiet here that only waves, wind, and the occasional bell brushing an eave remind visitors they have not yet stepped outside the mortal world.

name: Dead Silence Sea
desc: The Dead Sea is made of black islands and shadowed bays linked by narrow plank bridges, ruined ferry markers, and ghostfire lighthouses, so that from afar it resembles a city of specters drifting atop ink-dark waters. The sea surges without wind, and each rising wave carries a shriek like distant weeping. The halls and stone steps on the islands are stained gray-white and sickly green by clammy mist. At night, moonlight matters less than the soul lamps flickering through the fog, turning the whole region into something like the underworld seen in a dream.

name: Thousand Mechanisms Valley
desc: At first glance Qianji Valley looks like an ordinary mountain valley, with blue stone roads, elegant eaves, and carefully arranged courtyards and flowers. Only on approach does one realize that bridges can turn, walls can open and close, and even the height of the stairs conceals trigger mechanisms. Watchtowers and suspended bridges stand above, while secret tunnels, workshops, and sealed chambers lie below. Now and then one hears gear teeth bite, metal hum softly, or puppet footsteps approach from nowhere. The most terrifying thing here is not a single trap, but that the whole valley is itself a giant machine.

name: Gold-Squandering Cave
desc: The Gilded Den lies in a private heaven hidden behind a prosperous market city. At the entrance are seas of lanterns, drifting incense, curved bridges, and layered pavilions over the water. The deeper one goes, the more the clamor fades and the more lingering the sounds of water and music become. Outer terraces glitter with gold and jade and overflow with guests, while deeper within lie quiet rooms, hot springs, and dream pools hidden behind gauze, flower walls, and mist. Everything here is beautiful and luxurious, yet it is impossible to tell whether one has come to feast, to dream, or to step into a subtler kind of cultivation.

name: Pudu Island
desc: Pudu Island hangs alone in the center of the Storm Sea. Outside its shores, colossal waves rise and lightning churns, yet within, bells and Buddhist light press the island into an almost frozen calm. The Vajra Pagoda stands at the center, ringed by temple halls, stone steps, sea-cliff austerity platforms, and a harbor facing the water. Golden bells at the top ring with the sea wind and seem to smooth the storm little by little. When morning mist lifts, gold light falls over black reefs and pale halls, and the island looks like a sacred seal lifted from an angry sea.

name: Shadow Swamp
desc: Shadow Marsh never sees true daylight. Poison fog, foul water, and tangled ancient trees seal the whole region shut, and intruders are often watched by unseen eyes before they ever glimpse the mountain gate. The real stronghold is not concentrated on the surface: hidden towers and rope bridges lie in the canopy, while tunnels, cells, and miasma-covered entrances spread beneath the bog. There is almost no open line of sight here, only cold lamps flickering through drifting mist and black waters ready to swallow the sound of footsteps at any moment.

name: Myriad Treasures Floating Island
desc: Duobao Floating Isles are not one island but a chain of differently sized sky-islands linked by giant chains, cloud bridges, and cloudship routes into an immortal city suspended in the heavens. The outer ring is filled with busy docks and cargo yards, the middle levels with trade streets, auction houses, and markets, and the heights with forging towers that vent furnace fire day and night. After dark, lamps run along chains and skyways into the clouds, making the whole region look like a golden mercantile web spread across the sky, forever noisy and forever in motion.

name: Echo Valley
desc: Echo Valley narrows between towering cliffs, naturally forming countless resonance holes and sound fissures. Even a single plucked note can whirl through the valley for a long time without fading. Pavilions, waterside terraces, qin towers, and corridors follow the mountain contours while streams run straight through the buildings. On the surface it is as graceful as an immortal retreat, yet careful listening reveals that wind past the eaves and drops striking water seem rearranged by an unseen hand. The valley is often most dangerous not when music fills it, but when everything suddenly falls silent.

name: Maze Heaven
desc: Mizhongtian appears to be only a solitary peak, but once one enters the mountain gate, terraces, steps, bridges, and roads all prove to be embedded inside layers of folded space. The same road may look completely different when seen from before and after. On the slopes stand plazas engraved with array patterns, corridors suspended in midair, and halls that fade in and out of sight, while lines of light sometimes flow across the ground as if the mountain itself were slowly thinking. There is no stable sense of direction here; every step feels like entering another world.

name: Aurora Heaven Realm
desc: Aurora Heaven lies in the depths of the far northern eternal night. Beyond it stretch silent ice plains, yet this palace city alone is bathed year-round in moving aurora bright as day. Lofty ice walls, black-iron gates, frozen bridges, and training grounds gleam beneath the shifting light, while deep within the city the sacred flame altar casts a steady warmth-red glow through the cold. Its beauty is not merely grandeur, but the ordered coexistence of ice and fire, stillness and radiance, as if the whole city were a flame enduring inside the deepest winter.

name: Sage Forest
desc: The Forest of Sages stands where central spirit veins converge, filled with towering ancient trees and scattered stone steles. Lecture halls, libraries, and waterside courtyards are tucked among the shade, and anyone walking there must often pass along leaf-strewn paths and corridors carved with classical inscriptions. By day, the sound of reading travels far with the forest wind; by night, the steles emit a faint glow under the moon, leaving trees and eaves wrapped in quiet dignity. The place feels less like a closed sect and more like a living academy still growing with time.

name: Asura Blood Pool
desc: The mountain above the Shura Blood Pool is dark red through and through, with blood-colored mist and heat rising constantly from its cracks. Deep inside the mountain, immense underground blood pools and layered sacrificial halls have been hollowed out of the earth. Iron chain bridges span blood rivers, and stone stairs descend toward battle platforms, bone caves, and altars lit by scarlet light. The deeper one goes, the heavier the scent of rust, medicine, and damp blood becomes. The entire stronghold feels like a monstrous beast breathing slowly beneath the ground.
